INSTRUCTIONS
TOTENDERERS
GENERALITIES
1.

Introduction

1.1

The purpose of these Instructions is provided the Tenderers with the necessary information and
instructions to enable them to prepare and submit their Tenders in a coordinated manner and to
establish the procedure to be followed up to the time when the Contract is awarded.
Deevar Developers (Pvt) is establishing their "Zameen Opal Project" on their Site at Plot # 16 Land
Breez Society Raiwind Road Lahore over a Plot area of approx. 45,540 Ft2 with a Project covered
area approx. 265,124 Ft2, for which CONSTRUCTION OF ZAMEEN OPAL PHASE -II "Grey Structure
© Labour Rate covered Area Base" is to be started immediately and completed within 540
calendar days.

C

The Project comprises construction of Apartment Building in reinforced concrete in generally 02
basements, ground floor and 1 to 6 stories construction, foundations, retaining/core walls.
boundary wall, mumty, OHWT, UGWT, Main Buildings, Civil works, M.E.P works etc.
The project is to be completed in a strict scheduLe of 540 calendar days for which Covered Area
Rate tenders is being issued.
1.2

Any Tender which does not conform with these Instructions to Tenderers may be rejected.

2.

Tender Documents

2.01

The following documents have been prepared for tendering purposes and must be used by the
Tenderer when submitting his Tender.
(i)
(ii)
(iii)
(iv)
(v)

Technical Specifications
Drawings
Geotechnical Investigation Report
Addenda & Corrigenda

2.02

Tenderers are also deemed to be in possession of all Standard Specifications, Codes of Practice
and such like documents (ACI, UBC, BSS, BSCP, PS, ASTM, AASHTO etc), current on the date of
opening tenders, which are referred to in the Tender Documents and which are necessary to be
examined in the preparation and submission of the Tender and execution of Works.

3.

Other contractors / Approved Manufacturers
All other contractors that the Tenderer proposes to use, are subject to the acceptance of the
Employer.

4

ZAMEEN OPAL (Phase — II) - Page 1 of5

*

IT-2
INSTRUCTIONS
TO TENDERERS
The Contractor shalt be required to obtain prior written approval of the Employer before
employing any other contractor for any or special nature of the Works.
4.

ConfidentiaLity

4.01

ALL Tenderers and other recipients of the Tender Documents (whether or not they submit a
Tender) shall treat all details of the documents as Private and ConlidentiaL and shall neither
disclose nor release the information contained therein for any other use or purpose than that
intended.

4.02

The Tender Documents shall remain the property of the Employer and all unused Tender
Documents shall be returned to the Employer.

5.

ResponsibiLity of Tenderers

5.01

Each Tenderer shall inspect and examine each Site and its surroundings and shall satisfy himself
before submitting his Tender as to the nature of the ground, the hydrological and climatological
conditions, the form and nature of the Site, the quantities and nature of the Work and materials
necessary for the completion of the Works, and the means of access to the Site, the
accommodation he may require, laws, byelaws and regulations, and, in general, shall himself
obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies and other circumstances which may
influence or affect his Tender.

5.02

Any neglect or failure on the part of the Tenderer to obtain all relevant information shall not be
considered a reason for extension of time, nor for additional payments in accordance with the
Conditions of Contract, nor shall it relieve him from any risks or liabilities or from the
responsibility of completing and handing over the Works as required.

5.03

The Tenderer shall be entirely responsible for the cost of tendering (if any). The Employer shall
not be responsible for, nor pay for any loss, damage, cost or expense which may be incurred by
any Tenderer.

6.

Clarifications During The Tender Preparation Period

6.01

Should there by any doubt or obscurity as to the meaning of the Tender Documents or as to
anything to be done or not to be done under the Contract the Tenderer must describe in writing
such doubts or obscurity and deliver the same to the Employer at least three days before the
date of tender submission. Any such doubt or obscurity does not allow permission for extension
in submitting the tender.

6.02

A formal Addendum & Corrigendum will be issued as necessary to all Tenderers amending or
explaining the Tender Documents.

6.03

Such Addenda & Corrigenda shall have the status of documents provided for the purpose of
tendering.

INSTRUCTIONS

TENDER PREPARATION
7.

CompLetion Of The Forms Provided

7.01

Tenderers shalt fill in the blank spaces in the Tender Documents provided for the purpose of
tendering as follows:
Tender and Appendices
Summary of Cost! Bill of Quantities (attached)

7.02

The Tenderers shall enter Covered Area unit rate and fill-in the amounts in Summary of Cost/Bill
of Quantities accordingly. Items against which no rate or price is entered by the Tenderer shall be
deemed to be covered by other rates and prices in the Tender. Unit rates or prices shall be
entered in figures.
The tender is a Covered Area Rate tender. The Covered Area is estimated. The Contractor's rates
shall therefore be valid for quantities required till the completion of Project, and he should
satisfy himself about the sufficiency of rates for any quantity increase /decrease. The quantities
in Summary of Cost/Bill of Quantities can be ±25%, overall, and no limit on variation for
individual items. After award on mutual consent the unit rates may be applied to construction of
other buildings/floors as welL

7.03

The Tenderer shalt be deemed to have satisfied himself before tendering as to the correctness
and sufficiency of his Tender for the Works and of the rates and prices stated by him in the
Summary of Cost/Bill of Quantities which Tender rates and prices shall, except in so far as it is
otherwise provided in the Documents, cover all his obligations under the Contract and all
matters and things necessary for the proper execution, completion and maintenance of the
Works.

8.

Documents To Be Submitted With The Tender

8.01

Authority (Power of Attorney or attested copy thereof) of the signatory authorised to sign the
Tender and the Contract Agreement.

8.02

Preliminary Programme/Construction Schedule giving the out-line time table for completing the
Works and showing the order in which the various sections of the Works are to be constructed
together with the time estimation in each case.

8.03

In order to be considered, Tender must be accompanied by a Tender Security in the form and in
the amount stated in the Appendix A to Tender. The Tender Security shall remain valid for not
less than the period of validity of Tender Security stated in the Appendix A to Tender.
Tender Securities of unsuccessful Tenderers will be returned by the Employer upon award of the
Contract or expiry of the Period of validity of Tender, whichever is earlier.
The Tender Security of the successful Tenderer will be adjusted against the Retention Money
payable by him from his monthLy payments for the work done. Should the successful Tenderer
refuse or fail for any reason to execute the Contract Agreement the entire sum of the Tender

ZAMEEN OPAL (Phase — II) - Page 3 of5

IT-4
INSTRUCTIONS
TO TENDERERS
Security shall be forfeited to the Employer as liquidated damages for the successful Tenderers
failure to perform.
8.04

Tenders which are not accompanied by the above said documents are liable to be rejected.

9.

Language of the Tender

9.01

AlL entries in the Tender are to be made in the English language.

10.

Other Matters

10.01
10.02

All prices, rates, cost information shall be given in Pakistani rupees.
All taxes, duties, and other legal levies are on account of tenderer / Contractor (Except PRA). For
claiming any exemption valid exemption certificate from competent authorities to be submitted
in advance.

11.

Alteration of Tender Documents

11.01

No unauthorised alteration shall be made in the Tender Documents.

11.02

The only permitted changes to the Tender Documents will be notified by Addenda & Corrigenda
issued in accordance with the procedure.

SUBMISSION OF TENDER
12.

Date And PLace Of Submission

12.01

The Tender and supporting documents shall be delivered to the Employer not later than the time
and day stated below or as may have been amended by an Addendum & Corrigendum issued to
the Tenderers.

12.02

Tender submissions may be made earlier than the stated date and time in which case they shall
be kept safe.

13

Copies of Documents

13.01

The Tenderer may make and retain copy of all the documents making up his Tender submission
or additional copies of the Tender Documents may be had on payment.

14.

Signature Of Tender Documents

14.01

All the Tender Documents must be signed by the Principal duly authorised to represent and bind
the Tenderer, and shall be dated and seal affixed.

14.02

All drawings and other documents submitted are to be endorsed by the Tenderer with his official
seal.

14.03

Tenderers shall indicate in the space provided in the Tender their full and proper address at
which notices may be legally served on them and to which all correspondence in connection with
this Tender and the Contract is to be sent.

IT-5
INSTRUCTIONS
TO TENDERERS

15.

Wrapping and LabeLing Submission

15.01

All the documentation shall be placed in plain sealed packet(s) bearing the names of the Work.

15.02

The exterior of the sealed packet must not reveal the identity of the Tenderer.
If the Tender submission comprises more than one package, each package shall be marked with a
package number and indicate the total number of packages, e.g. Package No. 2 of 3.

POST TENDERING MATTERS
16.

Tender Receipt

16.01

The Employer will receive Tenders therein Addendum & Corrigendum at Deevar Developments
Head Office (3rd floor pearl one, 94-B/I. M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore)

16.012

It is the Tenderers responsibility to ensure that his Tender is received in time.

16.013

Any Tender which has not been received by the due time and date shall not be considered.

17.

Tender Opening

17.01

Tenders will be opened in a private ceremony "Deevar Developments".

18.

Tender Appraisal

18.01

Tenders will be checked to see that they are complete, unqualified and in accordance with these
Instructions.

18.02

Compliant Tenders will be checked for accuracy in computation and addition. Any errors of
whatever kind may be corrected by the Employer or their appointed representative and Tender
Price Sum amended accordingly. Errors in multiplying the quantities of items and the unit prices
or rates shall be adjusted by regarding the unit prices or rates as correct. Any adjustment made
in a Tender shall be made known to the Tenderer before acceptance of the Tender.

18.03

Tenderers may be called to explain all or part of their Tender should the Employer or their
appointed representative require it. These explanations may be called for in writing or by the
Tenderer attending meetings with the Employer or their appointed representative but does not
entitle any tenderer to subsequently revise the rates.

19.

Acceptance Of Tender

19.01

The successful Tenderer will be required to enter into and execute a Contract Agreement.

19.02

Written acceptance of the Tender shall constitute a contractual relationship between the parties
until such time as the formal Contract Agreement is signed.

19.03

The Employer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to award the work to the
iving any
lowest or any other tenderer, or to reject all tenders, at his sole discretion witho
reason to any tenderer.

Definitions

1.1

In the Contract (as hereinafter defined) the following words and expressions shall
have the meanings hereby assigned to them, except where the context otherwise
requires:

legal successors in title to such person, but not (except with the consent of the
Contractor) any assignee of such person.

Employer and the legal successors in title to such person, but not (except with the
consent of the Employer) any assignee of such person.
(iii) Subcontractor means any person named in the Contract as a Subcontractor
for a part of the Works or any person to whom a part of the Works has been
subcontracted with the consent of the Engineer and the legal successors in title to
such person, but not any assignee of any such person.

Sufficiency
of Tender

12.1

The Contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied himself as to the correctness and

Provisional Sum) and all matters and things necessary for the proper e

Adverse
PhysicaL
Obstructions or
Conditions

12.2

If, however, during the execution of the Works the Contractor encounters physical
obstructions or physical conditions, other than climatic conditions on the Site,
which obstructions or conditions were, in his opinion, not foreseeable by an
experienced contractor, the Contractor shall forthwith give notice thereof to the
Engineer, with a copy to the Employer. On receipt of such notice, the Engineer shall,
if in his opinion such obstructions or conditions could not have been reasonably
foreseen by an experienced contractor, after due consultation with the Employer
and the Contractor, determine:
(a) any extension of time to which the Contractor is entitled under Clause 44, and
(b) the amount of any costs which may have been incurred by the Contractor by
reason of such constructions or conditions having been encountered, which shall
be added to the Contract Price,
and shall notify the Contractor accordingly, with a copy to the Employer. Such
determination shall take account of any instr. on which the Engineer may issue
to the Contractor in connection therewith,

Contractor's
Superintendence

15.1

The
"tor shall provide all necessary superintendence during the execution of
the Works and as long thereafter as the Engineer may consider necessary for the
proper fulfilling of the Contractor's obligations under the Contract. The Contractor,

shall, as soon as is practicable, having regard to the requirement of replacing him
as hereinafter mentioned, after receiving notice of such withdrawal, remove the
representative from the Works and shall not thereafter employ him again on the
Works in any capacity and shall replace him by another representative approved
by the Engineer.

Adjoining
Properties

29.1

All operations necessary for the execution and completion of the Works and the
remedying of any defects therein shall, so far as compliance with the requirements

of, or in relation to, any such matters insofar as the Contractor is responsible
therefore.

Avoidance of
Damage to Roads

30.1

The Contractor shall use every reasonable means to prevent any of the roads or
bridges communicating with or on the routes to the Site from being damaged or
injured by any traffic of the Contractor or any of his Subcontractors and, in
particular, shall select routes, choose and use vehicles and restrict and distribute
loads so that any such extraordinary traffic as wiLl inevitably arise from the moving
of materials, Plant, Contractor's Equipment or Temporary Works from and to the
Site shall be limited, as far as reasonably possible, and so that no U
damage or injury may be occasioned to such roads and bridges.

contract which the Employer may enter into in connection with or ancillary to the

with the Employer and the Contractor and shall notify the Contractor of the
determination, with a copy to the Employer. No final review shall result in a decrease
of any extension of time already determined by the Engineer.

52.1

are required to be determined in accordance with Clause 52 (for the purposes of
this Clause referred to as "varied work), shall be valued at the rates and prices set

If the Contract does not contain any rates or prices applicable to the varied work,

between the Engineer and the Contractor. In the event of disagreement the
Engineer, within a period not exceeding one-eighth of the completion time subject
to a minimum of 56 days from the date of disagreement whichever is Later, shall
fix such rates or prices as are, in his opinion, appropriate and shall notify the
Contractor accordingly, with a copy to the Employer. Until such time as rates or
prices are agreed or fixed, the Engineer shall determine provisional rates or prices
to enable on-account payments to be included in certificates issued in accordance
with Clause 60.
